hero_concept.primary_text:
Cookie Doh Cashew Butter tastes like the spoon you swipe from the mixing bowl. Except this one has 5g of plant protein, 1g of sugar, and healthy fats that actually keep you full.

One pouch. No spoon. No jar to hide from your kids. Just tear the top and squeeze.

Built for the gym bag, the school pickup line, and the 9pm couch. Try the Cookie Doh pouch today.
hero_concept.visual_direction: A single Cookie Doh pouch photographed torn open at the top with a thick ribbon of cashew butter squeezing out onto a wooden board, shot from directly above.
hero_concept.fills_gap: Right now every image ad you have is the pouch sitting still next to a wall of six review quotes. Nothing in your account actually shows what the cashew butter looks like coming out of the pouch, which is the whole reason someone would try it.
hero_concept.image_prompt: A photorealistic editorial product photograph featuring the product from the reference image, styled in a clean overhead flat-lay on a warm wooden cutting board with a torn foil top and a thick glossy ribbon of cookie dough cashew butter squeezing out of the pouch onto the board, with soft directional daylight from the upper left creating gentle shadows. Warm, appetizing, editorial food-photography aesthetic with muted natural tones and no clutter. Square 1:1 composition with breathing room top and bottom for ad text overlay. CRITICAL - preserve the exact Cookie Doh Cashew Butter pouch as shown in the reference: preserve the exact pouch colorway, the 'Party Pump' brand mark, the 'Cookie Doh' flavor name text, the cashew illustration, the nutrition callouts, and every printed graphic, color, and text element exactly as they appear on the pouch - strictly NO color shift on the pouch, NO altering, removing, or re-typesetting any printed text or graphics on the packaging, NO swap to a different flavor's colorway. STRUCTURE - preserve the exact construction: single upright 1oz squeeze pouch shape with a torn/opened top edge, gusseted bottom that lets it stand, matte foil finish, all front-of-pouch printed elements (brand mark, flavor name, illustration, nutrition callouts) exactly as shown in the reference. Do NOT add a second pouch, do NOT change pouch shape or size, do NOT add a cap or spout not present in the reference, do NOT relocate or resize any printed graphics or text on the pouch, do NOT alter the illustration or nutrition callouts. Render the product's metal, color, finish, fabric, weave, stones, surface treatment, AND every visible construction detail (silhouette, closures, hardware count, pockets, sleeves, neckline, printed graphics) EXACTLY as they appear in the reference image. Do NOT change the metal type, do NOT shift the color temperature, do NOT introduce tones not present in the reference, do NOT add or remove buttons, snaps, zippers, pockets, straps, or any hardware, do NOT alter the silhouette, do NOT remove or modify printed graphics or text on the garment. IMPORTANT: the 'no text' and 'no logos' items in the NEGATIVE list below apply ONLY to text or logos added as overlay to the photograph itself - text, logos, graphics, prints, and brand labels that exist ON the product in the reference image are part of the product and must be preserved exactly. Premium commerce photography quality.
